title: Flat constructible sheaves lift epimorphisms
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $X$ a Noetherian scheme. Work in the category $C=\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\operatorname{ModuleCat}(\Lambda))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site; def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. In this statement constructible means the source predicate $\operatorname{IsConstructibleSheaf}$ [def-constructible-constructible]: a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which the pullbacks are locally constant with finitely generated geometric stalks. A sheaf $E$ is flat when $E\otimes-$ is exact. For every epimorphism $p:A\to B$ in $C$ and map $g:G\to B$ from a constructible $G$, there exist a flat constructible sheaf $E$, an epimorphism $e:E\to G$, and $h:E\to A$ with $p\circ h=g\circ e$.
